name: Ants Empire
desc:
Ants Empire is an incremental simulator where you create, command, and customize your colony of ants to maximize profits from harvesting and take out any bugs that step in your path.

🍓Explore fields of tasty sweet fruits
🛠️Retrieve resources to the nest
🐜Expand your ant colony, by numbers or by strength
🐞Attack dangerous bugs and claim their rewards
🌱Explore a vast world of the undergrowth
